rules.stock: Stock Account Normal balance (one per outlet); headline measure
rules.other: rekening tanpa label Account Type (lainnya); komisi = Commission Transaction Account; keduanya terpisah dari stok
rules.avg: Average Transaction Amount of the stock account (daily); inventory days = balance / avg when avg > 0
rules.sellin: saldo sell-in from DAILY_DATA_MOBII: y = cut day, p = day before, mt = MTD, sf = September full, sl = LMTD
rules.mapping: outlet id (IM3 or 3ID, leading zeros stripped) -> master outlet, else ad-hoc outlet; unmapped outlets are only counted
